children: WAYLAND, MA, September 4th, 2026, FinanceWire
SoftPak Financial Systems builds software that helps investors manage portfolios, operate investments, and manage risk profiles while providing client service.

Efficient technology is a necessity for investment firms and advisors dealing with large numbers of accounts and layered investing strategies. Manual management of portfolios becomes a time sink and creates inconsistencies across accounts in the management of investment positions.
SoftPak Financial Systems designs technology to help manage layers of investments and operate the firm’s investments while the firm retains visibility and control over its portfolio.

The firm provides a system that provides the opportunity to automate processes for managing and growing portfolios. This system also helps manage risk for the firm and report performance to clients. Other automations include managing and operating accounts under mandates, accounting and reporting to clients, and managing relationships with clients.
Helping Financial Firms Improve Portfolio Management

SoftPak specializes in rebalancing portfolios. The UREBAL Universal Rebalancer lets financial professionals automate the process of bringing their investment accounts back in line with their models and investment strategies.

Automated rebalancing reduces repetitive work for firms and also leads to more consistent portfolios. This makes it worth the cost for RIAs, wealth managers, asset managers, and any other firm that has to manage lots of client accounts.

SoftPak has technology for managed accounts that provides rebalancing, model management, portfolio management, and risk reporting. Investment firms can use these services to address individual account needs while having a more comprehensive view of how their portfolios interact.
Supporting Risk Management and Investment Decisions

Risk management is another important component of SoftPak's financial technology solutions. The company's enterprise risk management technology is designed to provide financial organizations with a consolidated view of portfolio risk across different asset classes.

Investment firms need reliable information when assessing exposure and monitoring portfolio performance. SoftPak's solutions are designed to help financial professionals analyze portfolios and access information that can support more informed investment decisions.
By bringing portfolio management and risk management capabilities into an integrated technology environment, firms can reduce reliance on disconnected processes and improve operational visibility.
Portfolio Management Software for Financial Advisors

Increasingly, financial advisers and wealth management companies need software that will allow them to conduct investment management while being compatible with their current business processes. Using the right Portfolio Management Software will help them organize portfolio data, automate processes, monitor their investments, and report on them.

SoftPak Financial Systems specializes in developing products that meet these needs. SoftPak technology enables portfolio optimization and rebalancing, manages accounts, performs analytics of the performance of investment, manages risks, and more.

Moreover, SoftPak provides customized and white-label development of fintech products for those organizations that need tailor-made solutions. Financial companies can implement solutions that will work well with their business process, their investment strategy, and goals.
More Than Three Decades of Fintech Experience

Founded in 1994, SoftPak Financial Systems boasts more than 30 years of experience in developing technology for financial service organizations. It serves asset managers, wealth advisers, RIA, TAMP, financial organizations, and other businesses requiring investment management technology.

SoftPak leverages expertise in the financial industry combined with software development to create solutions for organizations handling complicated investment operations. Its experience is in portfolio management, quantitative analysis, risk management, performance measurement, and financial software development.
The firm's technology has facilitated over 500 million transactions, and its renewal rate demonstrates that it continues to have clients among financial organizations utilizing its technology.
"Financial organizations need technology that helps their teams work more efficiently while giving them greater control over investment operations," said
Naaz Scheik, CEO and Founder of SoftPak Financial Systems
. "Our goal is to provide practical financial technology that addresses real operational challenges and helps investment professionals manage portfolios with greater efficiency and confidence."
Building Technology for the Future of Wealth Management

With increasing emphasis on automation, transparency, and efficiency in the financial sector, there will be continued demand for investment technology. Portfolio management software can serve as a valuable tool for financial companies as they deal with rising numbers of accounts and the need for consistent investment procedures.

SoftPak Financial Systems continues to concentrate its efforts on producing technology that is specific to the field of investment management, including portfolio rebalancing, risk management, performance reports, managed accounts, and other finance-related operations.

By merging financial and software knowledge, SoftPak strives to assist financial institutions in improving their technological capabilities and implementing more effective procedures for handling investments and their clients.
About SoftPak Financial Systems

SoftPak Financial Systems is a global software company that provides investment, portfolio, and wealth management software. The company was founded in 1994, and it develops technologies for use by asset managers, wealth managers, RIAs, TAMPs, and financial firms.

These services provide portfolio rebalancing, portfolio optimization, managed accounts, enterprise risk management, performance reporting, account monitoring, billing, and client management technology.
